title.zh: 刑事诉讼法典（指定执法机构）公告 2026
title.en: Criminal Procedure Code (Prescribed Law Enforcement Agency) Notification 2026

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification is the Criminal Procedure Code (Prescribed Law Enforcement Agency) Notification 2026 and comes into operation on 12 February 2026.
2. The Corrupt Practices Investigation Bureau is prescribed as a law enforcement agency for the purposes of section 112(1)(c) of the Code.
